descriptionMarkdown:
I like big platforms and I can not lie. (Requires a lot of resources, and Aqulo made power, while a lot legendary can be downgraded, could possibly make it nuclear based if removed all beacons but.....)

Modified version of https://www.factorio.school/view/-OFqXLjhPzRw4iDXGbNG

Creates 40k of all the base science packs apart from Production and Military.

Loved the blueprint but was extreamly hard to launch. Removed a bunch of unneeded Cargo bays and can now import ice to the platform to kickstart fuel production. (Add ice import for whatever plant you are on/have it on)

It was throwing oodles of ice offboard while few oxide chunks were making it to main factory while in rotation thorugh the inner planets. First adjusted ice, but found a couple of decider combinators to change between just ice and advanced (with calcite) recipies reliably improved it so did not need to ditch ice at all.

While it leaves crushers in a state most of the time that they are not working when that occurs they are not needed, when stuff is needed they clear up and start working.

Random other mods like a bunch of Storage Tanks on the left, don't do much but does increase fuel storage and initial thrust as not enough fuel to continiously supply all engines.

Mostly its here so I can find it when I want it again if I lose the blueprint, but hope others find it useful!
title: Jank adapted Bee's Space Science
